projects.title: City Park Needs Cleaning & Waste Bins
projects.description: Our neighborhood park has suffered from littering and lack of proper segregation bins. We want to organize a mass cleanup drive, install 6 weatherproof recycling bins, and plant flower beds along the walking trail.
projects.location: Green Valley Community Park, North Ward
projects.volunteer_skills_needed: Trash collection, gardening, waste segregation, physical stamina

projects.title: Local Primary School Needs Storybooks & Reading Corner
projects.description: The Government Primary School in Riverside currently lacks children books for grades 1-5. We aim to set up an inviting library corner with 200+ illustrated storybooks, small beanbags, and sturdy wooden shelves.
projects.location: Riverside Govt Primary School, South Extension
projects.volunteer_skills_needed: Book cataloging, reading aloud to children, painting library wall murals

projects.title: Community Center Needs 5 Refurbished Computers
projects.description: Underprivileged youth in our locality need digital literacy access. We want to procure 5 refurbished desktop computers, mice, keyboards, and basic internet connectivity for open evening study sessions.
projects.location: East Ward Civic Community Center, Market Road
projects.volunteer_skills_needed: Computer setup, basic MS Office/typing tutoring, hardware cabling

projects.title: Plant 150 Native Shade Trees in Neighborhood
projects.description: With rising summer heat, our streets need green canopy. We are coordinating with local authorities to plant 150 native neem, peepal, and gulmohar saplings with protective tree guards.
projects.volunteer_skills_needed: Digging pits, sapling handling, watering coordination

projects.title: Renovate the Local Children Playground
projects.description: The swing sets are rusted and the rubber safety tiles have degraded. We need funds to sandblast the frames, install two new safety swings, a seesaw, and safe child-friendly cushioning.
projects.location: Railway Colony Public Ground, West Sector
projects.volunteer_skills_needed: Carpentry, metal painting, safety inspection, weekend supervision

projects.title: Free Health & Eye Checkup Camp for Senior Citizens
projects.description: Organizing a comprehensive weekend medical health screening camp including eye checkups, blood sugar testing, and free reading glasses distribution for over 150 elderly neighborhood residents.
projects.location: Community Hall, Sunshine Senior Housing Society
projects.volunteer_skills_needed: Registration assistance, queue management, guiding seniors, hospitality

project_updates.title: Dustbin procurement vendor finalized!
project_updates.description: We have negotiated a 15% community discount with a local manufacturer for 6 high-density weatherproof segregation bins. Cleanup drive scheduled for next weekend!

project_updates.title: Target reached! Book purchase underway
project_updates.description: Thank you generous community! We have reached our 100% funding goal of ₹20,000. Book cataloging starts this Thursday at Riverside School.
